During the [[Clone Wars]], a '''''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle''' served within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], where it was utilized as the personal [[shuttle]] of the [[Kaleesh]] Separatist [[General]] [[Grievous]], who was gifted the craft by the confederate government as a result of his high-ranking position. In [[19 BBY]], Grievous utilized the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] in his transportation to the [[planet]] [[Utapau]] in the war's final [[Standard day|days]].

==Description==
As a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], the [[Starship|vessel]]<ref name="Episode III" /> measured to 14.4 [[meter]]s in length<ref name="Size" /> and was propelled by two [[engine]] units equipped at its stern. Owned by the [[Kaleesh]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] [[General]] [[Grievous]], the [[shuttle]] retained its initial [[cockpit]]<ref name="BMF 54" /> from where the craft was [[pilot]]ed by two [[OOM pilot battle droid]]s<ref name="Episode III" /> as opposed to the automated piloting systems implemented into the ''Sheathipede''-class vessels utilized by [[Neimoidian]]s.<ref name="BMF 54" /> Furthermore, the shuttle also possessed forward mounted lights as well as an aft-mounted [[blast door]] from where the craft's main cabin was accessible from a retractable boarding ramp.<ref name="Episode III" />

==History==
[[File:GrievousShuttle2-ROTS.png|thumb|left|250px|The shuttle lands on the planet Utapau.]]
At some point during the [[time]] of the [[Clone Wars]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic]] and Confederacy of Independent Systems, the confederate government presented the Kaleesh General Grievous, the [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Martial Commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army]], with a personal ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle as a result of the Confederacy's consideration of him as a high-ranking individual within the government.<ref name="BMF 54" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> several [[Standard day|days]] after the Confederacy's failed [[Battle of Coruscant|assault]] on the Republic [[capital]] [[Planet|world]]<ref name="SWGA" /> of [[Coruscant]], which resulted in Grievous's succession of the [[Death|deceased]] confederate leader, [[Count]] [[Dooku]], as [[Head of State]], the Kaleesh was transported to the planet [[Utapau]] in an attempt to conceal himself within the [[Outer Rim Territories]], where he was brought aboard a Separatist [[Unidentified core ship|stronghold]] on the [[Level 10|tenth level]] of the capital, [[Pau City]].<ref name="Episode III" />

==Commanders and crew==
Gifted by the Separatist Alliance as a result of his high-ranking position within the government, the ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle was owned as the personal shuttle of the Kaleesh Separatist General Grievous during the Clone Wars. In addition, the shuttle was piloted by a pair of OOM pilot [[battle droid]]s as opposed to the automated piloting systems implemented into the ''Sheathipede''-class vessels of Neimoidians, which Grievous had chosen to disregard.<ref name="BMF 54" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grievous's ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle was introduced in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III" />
